criteria.description: Are material facts, arithmetic, statuses, and certainty supported by the supplied sources? Score the visible artifact, not the producing agent's summary.
anchors: No usable factual result or core facts are invented.
Several material claims are false, unsupported, or contradictory.
The main answer is present but at least one consequential claim is unsupported or wrong.
Core facts are supported; only a minor claim or qualification needs correction.
All material facts and qualifications are supported, and uncertainty is retained.

criteria.description: Does the artifact complete the requested user job, including required figures, decisions, next actions, and follow-up constraints?
anchors: No usable deliverable was produced.
The deliverable misses the main purpose of the task.
A useful start exists, but consequential requested elements are missing.
The requested job is mostly complete with small omissions or cleanup.
The requested job is complete and directly usable.

criteria.description: Is the text appropriate for the specified audience, especially when turning internal material into customer or partner communication? For presentations, score visible slide text only; visual layout requires separate human inspection.
anchors: The artifact exposes prohibited information or is unusable for the audience.
Tone or content has a serious audience mismatch.
Audience fit is mixed and requires substantial rewriting.
Audience fit is good with minor tone or clarity edits.
The artifact is clear, concise, and appropriate for the audience.

criteria.description: How much work would a user need before using the artifact? Judge only what is visible in the deliverable and supplied evidence.
anchors: The user must redo the task from scratch.
The user must rebuild most of the deliverable.
The user must make several substantive edits.
Only small edits or formatting cleanup remain.
No material edits are needed.
